project_goal: Build and train a small streaming-specific, single-pass decision model that maps measured network/player state and available representations to one bitrate choice at each segment request
design_inspiration: Laya-like bounded decision interface; numeric streaming encoder and learned candidate scorer, not a port of Laya's text encoder or weights
research_question: Can this streaming-specific decision model preserve or improve playback outcomes under unseen network groups, videos, bitrate ladders and live timing while meeting a measured batch-one inference-cost target?
novelty_status: unproven; small recurrent models and candidate scoring are baselines, not novelty claims

environment_training_scope.supported_now: Finite trace-driven, segment-boundary Gym interaction for VOD and finite low-latency live; simulated clocks advance through each action and return the next observation, reward and elapsed time
environment_training_scope.not_supported_now: Live network collection, wall-clock player control, per-part bitrate actions, late live joins, request cancellation or unbounded streams
environment_training_scope.trace_caution: Observed goodput can depend on the collecting policy; do not interpret it as action-independent capacity without validation
environment_training_scope.next_gate: Audit measured traces and packaged media, then validate simulator timing against controlled real-player captures before relying on trained-policy comparisons
environment_training_scope.training_contract_needed: Define score meaning, objective, discounting for unequal elapsed decisions, transition logging, truncation handling and checkpoint provenance before policy training
environment_training_scope.deployment_gate: Implement and validate a player-side measurement and decision adapter; browser timing capture alone is not a training feed or deployed policy

baseline_requirements.comparison_note: Laya is an interface inspiration, not a trained streaming baseline; compare playback to ABR controllers and inference cost to a specified learned ABR reference
baseline_requirements.implementation_status: Only diagnostic baselines exist in V2; other baselines require implementation and verification

split_rules.unit: collection session/group, never individual correlated segments
split_rules.video_unit: source video, including all encodings and parts
split_rules.selection: training data for optimization; validation only for tuning and checkpoint selection
split_rules.final_test: freeze data hashes, cases, code, weights, hardware and acceptance thresholds before final test; no test-driven retuning
split_rules.failure_reporting: retain all timeout, incomplete and failed episodes; never rank quality using successful episodes alone

metrics.quality: playback-weighted measured VMAF from packaged video; log bitrate is an engineering proxy only
metrics.compute_controls: fixed hardware, runtime, threads, precision and batch size; warm up; include preprocessing and action selection; measure cold start separately
metrics.uncertainty: report every training seed; paired comparisons on identical cases; resample independent network/video groups rather than segments; do not treat all seeds times all segments as independent samples

primary_claim.type: lower inference computation with noninferior playback outcomes
primary_claim.rule: set margins with validation/pilot evidence before final test; a smaller parameter count alone does not establish lower latency

tolerance_status: provisional engineering thresholds, not established equivalence bounds; review on calibration cases and freeze before independent validation
publication_rules: Separate implementation, reproduction, simulation findings and real-player evidence. Report negative results and limitations. No novelty or improvement claim before experiments.

candidate_model_status.implementation: dense and GRU candidate scorers constructed; no ABR training yet
candidate_model_status.shared_contract: observation v2 + public streaming context; variable candidate count; uncalibrated scores
candidate_model_status.training_method: not implemented; architecture does not require PPO
candidate_model_status.evidence: architecture/integration tests only; no streaming improvement or novelty established
